title: filter~
description: `filter~` is an analog-style multimode audio filter supporting 24 dB/octave low-pass and 12 dB/octave low-pass, high-pass, and band-pass modes, with `LP24` as the default. Its audio input is clipped between -1 and 1, and the character control ranges from clean at 0 through Moog-like at 50% to dirty at 100%, especially with high resonance.
